graders.name: applicable
graders.criteria: Judge the new rule in the edited `AGENTS.md`. An agent could apply it without asking what counts as a log. Pass if it states what docs keep instead (for example "facts and instructions"), or names or exemplifies what stays out (run or session logs, timelines, step-by-step records). The word "logs" beside what docs keep is enough.

graders.name: concise
graders.criteria: Compare the original and edited `AGENTS.md`. The change adds the one rule the user gave, stated about as briefly as the existing rules, without extra explanation, examples or history, and changes nothing else.

graders.name: guardrail-paired
graders.criteria: Judge the new rule in the edited `AGENTS.md`. It states what docs should contain (facts and instructions), not only what to keep out.

graders.name: keeps-rest
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `AGENTS.md`. Every other rule keeps its meaning: project facts, the commands, the zod, cents and migration conventions, keeping `docs/` current with code, the two doc pointers, and the git rules.

graders.name: leading-words
graders.criteria: Judge the new rule in the edited `AGENTS.md`. It refers to the docs with the file's own terms (`docs/`, docs) rather than a new synonym such as "knowledge base" or "documentation repository".

graders.name: no-history
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `AGENTS.md`. It holds rules for the agent only: no mention that the agent wrote a log before or "again", and no note of why the rule was added.

graders.name: others-unchanged
graders.description: Only AGENTS.md changes; the request did not ask to clean up existing docs.

graders.name: placed-with-documentation
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `AGENTS.md`. The new rule sits in the existing Documentation section beside the other rules about `docs/`, not in a new section or elsewhere in the file.

graders.name: rule-added
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `AGENTS.md`. It now tells the agent that repository docs hold facts and instructions, not logs, and that a log goes in only when the user asks for one.
